name: GIO-1
author: Guinan
tagline: A generative electronic disco machine for the FM-1
description: A generative disco machine after Giorgio Moroder's Munich sound. It plays itself: a sequenced bass, strings or choir, a lead that answers what you play on the white keys, four-on-the-floor drums. Nine songs, each a form with its own chords. Pick a song, key and bass pattern; hold or skip sections.
credits: A fork of AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
